Results.ReviewText: Great kettle grill, easy to assemble and a good smoker
Results.Title: Great grill

ClientResponses.Response: HI, It is more accurate to have it on the top that way it can be more consistent. We have passed this information along. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: The included thermometer is positioned incorrectly to be effective in anything other than measuring the temperature at the top of the lid.  It would be more effective if it was positioned below the outlet vent as close to the grill as possible.
Results.Title: Thermometer's effectiveness

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love it! I am new to grilling and this has been perfect for me! I mean prep and make ALL my food for the week! No complaints! Not too hard to put together! Very easy to maintain and keep clean!
Results.Title: I love it!

ClientResponses.Response: Hi, We are sorry you are not having a great experience. The lid should not be easy to come off while it's on the bowl. We will get in touch with you via email to see how we can help you with this issue. Thank you,
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: It should be more obvious the lid doesn’t attach. I wouldn’t have bought this model if I had know or could tell by the description that the lid isn’t attached or doesn’t attach in some fashion.  I’ve already dropped my lid twice.  And as very particular person as far as keeping my things nice goes. It upset me greatly so me, so much I was on the verge of returning it. But I have wanted a Weber grill for a few years now.
Results.Title: The Detached Lid

Results.ReviewText: Grill is very versatile. I was between buying a smoker and the Weber Kettle and I’m glad I got it. Can do most things a smoker can do and more. It can do hot and fast really well for burgers, but can also smoke a pork shoulder at 225f for 12 hours no problem too. Best grill I’ve purchased.
Results.Title: Versatile Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Love this simple charcoal grill.  The ash catch is easy to empty and the grill space is plenty for our family of 4.
Results.Title: Great Charcoal Grill.

Results.ReviewText: You can’t go wrong with the original kettle grill! It’s not only high quality but beautiful. The charcoal starter is a must. It’s actually more versatile then we realized and of course everything we’ve cooked has been awesome.
Results.Title: Classic Kettle

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill to have one of my own instead of using my dad's old one. Gotta say what anice upgrade that was. The temp gauge on top is one of my favorite features and the ashtray trap is much better than the old open design. I have a couple of nit picks that by no mean diminishes the greatness of this grill but would be cool if Weber eliminated or fixed them. First is the hook under the lid to hang it on the grill should be to the sides on the handle, not in front. Kinda strenuous on the wrist with it in front. Next would be the vent at the bottom to dump the ashes, still not super effective and I end up using my hands. Again these are minor complains and more quality of life improvements. I absolutely love this grill and it has been working perfectly. My first use I smoked some New Yorks and they turned out perfect with plenty of flavor and nice and juicy!
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: Incredible, it suits every grill need possible. From burgers to smoking brisket.
Results.Title: Versatile

Results.ReviewText: I love it so far, I just got mine on Valentine’s from my wife, I’ve used it for steaks, lobster, shrimp, pizza with a lot. I love it. Maintains heat very well.
Results.Title: Well thought out grill

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Kettle has been around for years for a reason. Easy to use and clean with stellar results.
Results.Title: Old School Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: It came without the top cooking grate ..but customer service sent me one in a flash..no problem here
Results.Title: No cooking grate

Results.ReviewText: Love it! Grill in it as often as I can. Saved us during the winter storm we got here in Texas! Couldn’t use our stove, I had stocked up with lump and briquettes charcoal  a few weeks before the freeze. Lit the grill every meal for three days in a row! To say I’m happy with my grill is an insult. I’m beyond happy! I have convinced a few buddies to get a kettle.
Results.Title: Solid Grill

Results.ReviewText: This product is easy to assemble, well built and easy to use. I would definitely recommend and would buy it again.
Results.Title: Weber Grill

Photos.Caption: First cook on the new grill!

Results.ReviewText: I'm moving up from the bottom of the line 18" grill. The 18" was great for an intro to charcoal grilling, but once I got the hang of things it was time to move onto something bigger. I'm very happy with the size of the 22" and I'm glad I can fit a few racks of beef ribs if I need to!
Results.Title: Started at 18" and upgraded to 22"

Results.ReviewText: A really great grill that I'm glad i spent the money on it. Always heard how good they were but was reluctant to spend that much on it until i say how heavily built everything thing is-the racks are 3 times thicker than my last grill was so i know they will last a long time. The only problem I've found is the top vent gets scorching hot because there is no handle on it
Results.Title: Excellent purchase

Results.ReviewText: We use at least twice a week and it's such an upgrade over what we'd had (multiple ones from big box stores - none of them had vents in back and they all were very cheaply made and gave out fast).  It grills perfectly, the vents control the heat well, and we're saving so much charcoal being able to close it down completely when done.  It's a really pretty green too!
Results.Title: Don't buy anything but a Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill.  I enjoy slow cooking on it and food turns our super moist!
Results.Title: Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had a Weber grill for over 40 years love them
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: After grilling with gas grills for many years I was always thinking that charcoal was hard to clean and a lot of work. Then I saw a video of the weber Kettle 22" Original Premium with the ash cleaner and ash catcher. For $165.00 I had to try it. It is not only easy to clean but easy to use on many levels whether you are experienced or not. I immediately fell in love with charcoal grilling. I specially enjoy the versatility and have already purchased several accessories. I highly recommend this Weber grill.
Results.Title: Love at first bite

Results.ReviewText: Didn’t know how much I would enjoy a simple little kettle grill but this thing will cook just about anything
Results.Title: First Weber

Results.ReviewText: The grill is super. Easy to clean.  Easy to assemble. I do not use briquettes.  I use lump charcoal, and it works like a dream.   Controlling the air flow is simple and the temperature guage is easy to see. I would recommend this grill to anyone.  Additional items I would recommend to purchase are a good pair of grill gloves, and cover and coal chimney.
Results.Title: Its great.

Results.ReviewText: Excellent quality. I have owned lots of different brand of charcoal grills and thought Weber was just too expensive but now I realize I spent too much on those other grills and should have just bought a Weber to begin with.
Results.Title: Excellent quality

Results.ReviewText: Easy starting with the start up cubes and the chimney!  Also easy clean up not to mention how great the food tastes over a charcoal grill
Results.Title: Great charcoal grill cooking

Results.ReviewText: Good quality, fair price, quite the following amongst kettle owners.
Results.Title: Overall good choice

Results.ReviewText: I already have a weber kettle grill. The guage of metal in a weber is the reason i bought a 2nd. Also it grills great and the thing is bulletproof. I have had several other grills over the years and I finally went with Weber. Best made grill on the market.
Results.Title: Best On The Market

Results.ReviewText: Our original 22” grill, using it from 2-5 times a week, lasted for 42-years. Finally age degradation took its life. For many years the thanksgiving turkey was slow smoke roasted in this Weber. Lots of whole birds, pork roast, ribs and veggies found their way to the table through this kettle. It lived its life in and out of the Oregon weather. The new kettle is performing just as the original. Lots of secret recipes still working for all to enjoy.
Results.Title: Lived a long wonderful life.

Results.Title: Weber charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: I haven't used it yet but I'm already impressed!  This thing is built like a Sherman tank!  I couldn't believe how heavy the box was before opening it!  My son has the same model and he loves it, and that's why I bought this one.  I think we will be VERY happy with it!
Results.Title: Great charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Love it, all my family have one so I had to get it
Results.Title: Finally got mine

Results.ReviewText:
Once you learn to control the temperature and indirect cooking it’s great
Also bought a GrillGrate the bbq item I ever bought
Results.Title: Weber bbq

Results.ReviewText: The best charcoal grill I’ve ever cooked on.  The Weber Kettle is very versatile.
Results.Title: Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Once you start cooking.  Trust me you won’t cook any other way but BUY YOUR SELF THE WEBER SMOKEY MOUNTAIN
Results.Title: Loving my 22

Results.ReviewText: This is the ultimate grill. You can do everything on it, direct or indirect, fast or slow. I use it every week, easy to clean and with consistent results. There is plenty of accessories out of the market. The day this grill falls apart (which I’m seeing not happening on the long term) I will definitely get the same one.
Results.Title: Best grill ever!

Results.ReviewText: I have bought these grilles for many years. As the price has gone up Weber made valuable improvements to their product. This last time the price went up significantly and they cheapened this product by deleting the second bowl handle. Now there are two less hooks to to hang utensils and with the second bowl handle gone is harder to move the whole grille. I will NOT be buying Weber products any more. It may have been the last American Made grille out there, so I guess I am being forced to buy FOREIGN crap!
Results.Title: Finally engineered a crappy product!

Results.ReviewText: I only use Weber grills.  I own 2 kettles and one gas.  I love the simplicity, intelligence and constant small improvements made in design and ease of use.  If you could make a self-cleaning kettle.......
Results.Title: My Wonderful Webers

Results.ReviewText: The best grill in the world, Quality product to have a family fun day
Results.Title: A happy man on the grill

Results.ReviewText: I have used Weber grills since 1979, since my 1st grill experience. It’s the perfect charcoal grill.
Results.Title: Love of the Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Love my new Weber. Best purchase I've made to enjoy great food
Results.Title: Every household needs one

Results.ReviewText:
After 30+ years using a gas grill, I’m back to a Weber kettle and love it. For several years I’ve thought it’d be nice to have a charcoal grill but maybe only for occasional use. My wife gave me the Weber kettle for Christmas and I’m really enjoying it, I grill 3-4 times a week and while my gas Weber is just a bit more convenient, I find that the Weber kettle gives better results.
I compare it to listening to a CD vs. a vinyl record, the CD is certainly easier but doesn’t come close to vinyl in terms of the sound!
Results.Title: Back to a Weber kettle and loving it!

Results.ReviewText: Quality throughout, easily assembly and love the app and blog
Results.Title: No comparison

Results.ReviewText: I learned how to grill on a Weber and now I can teach my kids how to do so as well... Love it!!!
Results.Title: Original Gangster of Grills

Results.ReviewText: I am a new owner and have enjoyed using the grill. Looking forward to trying all the features.
Results.Title: New Owner

Results.ReviewText: Works great, grill is far enough from charcoal that food doesn’t burst into flames, even heating, easy to clean and it looks good
Results.Title: Kettle grill

Results.ReviewText: The most versatile grill for the price. Whether you want to slow smoke a bird or fire up a pizza. This baby does it all!
Results.Title: All You Need!

Results.ReviewText: What a great piece of hardware.  So versatile and easy to use with an incredibly supportive user community.  You want to cook something? You can do it on a 22" Kettle.  Weber Kettles should be as mandatory in your home as electricity and refrigerators.
Results.Title: Your Outdoor Cooking Must Have

Results.ReviewText: I've only used it a couple of times, but, I like it so far.  I seem to have not figured out how to get it hot, yet.
Results.Title: New to Weber

Results.ReviewText: This is my Weber grill that I bought in 1976 and I am still using it. It's been a great grill I use it as a smoker mostly. I thought about retiring it but why replace something that still works great. I don't know about the newer grills today but this old boy is still going strong.
Results.Title: Really good grill

Results.ReviewText: This is one great purchase. I will use this for my quick cooks or small smoke jobs. This can do it all. Need call and see if I can get warranty on the ash cleaner, one of the tines has bent upwards and won’t clean that side of the grill properly.
Results.Title: First Webber purchase.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. I bought the accessories to smoke ribs. It works well and I would recommend this grill to anyone who is looking for a smoker.
Results.Title: Kettle as a Smoker

Results.ReviewText: The Weber kettle is the most versatile outdoor cooking appliance for the money that you can buy. I hot and cold smoke, bake, and grill with mine. I'm on my third kettle in 40 years. Third not because they wore out, but because sometimes I just had to get a new one. I cook it all too. Beef, lamb, chicken, fish, ducks, turkey, ribs, butt, jerky, meat sticks, eggs, lox, cheese, steaks, roasts, burgers, hotdogs, brats, etc.
Results.Title: The Most Versatile Outdoor Cooking Appliance

Results.Title: Quality

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grilling work horse. You can do almost anything with this grill and a few aluminum pans. Keep it clean after a cook and it will last at least a decade.
Results.Title: Grill for the ages!

Results.ReviewText: Just an amazing product. I will never own another grill that doesn't say Weber on it.
Results.Title: Amazing product

Results.ReviewText:
Easy to use 
Easy to clean 
BBQ’s great
Easy to store
Results.Title: Weber kettle

Results.ReviewText: I used my son’s webber grill and really liked it, so I asked for one for my birthday and I got one. I love it, it’s very easy how you can control air flow and temperature. Weber did a good job on making the kettle.
Results.Title: First time owner of weber 22” kettle charcoal gril

Results.ReviewText: I love my Charcoal Kettle Grill!  There is nothing better than the way food tastes when cooked over real fire!  This one is easy to use and easy to maintain.
Results.Title: Love my grill!

Results.ReviewText: Nice product and works well but... One design flaw to be aware of... wheel base is such that when lifted to roll, the grill becomes top heavy and can easily tip over. The one (and only) time I tried to move the grill with the top in place it tipped back and the wheels shot forward, injuring my leg in the process.  Fortunately I wasn’t trying to move it while the coals were hot or it would have been extremely dangerous as the charcoal flew everywhere.
Results.Title: Nice product with one design flaw...

Results.ReviewText: First time owning and operating a charcoal grill. I'm not able to get the hang of it just yet due to the weather but I can't wait to fire this up more often when the weather turns!
Results.Title: First Time Owner/Operator

Results.ReviewText:
More space than you think. I have so far only grilled steaks. Wow, do they come out great; and so fun to make too! I am excited to soon make bacon and smoke lox.
During shipping, the lid was chipped. I contacted Weber support, and within minutes I had a new lid on the way.
Results.Title: Fantastic grill

Results.ReviewText: My old Weber kettle, after 20 some years,  needed a replacement. The new lower ventilation system helps to keep things at the proper desired cooking temp. After a complete seasoning, we have enjoyed a few meals.  We will be cooking for friends and family soon and we can't wait.
Results.Title: Oh YA

Results.ReviewText: In the colder temps, use extra coals. But we’re loving our grill!
Results.Title: Colder temps

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber grill, I'm very surprised how it's easy to use and the flavor of the food that we have grilled. The only problem I have found is about how to control the temperature, I suppose with the practice and time I should be able to control it.
Results.Title: great surprise

Results.ReviewText: I've had Weber Kettles for over 20 years and obviously i like them.  I like this grill a lot but why did Weber decide to change the orientation of the lid handle?  The original orientation had better leverage for hanging the lid on the side of the grill.  Other than that i love the grill.
Results.Title: Love the grill but...

Results.ReviewText: Very versatile grill. Many uses such as indirect and direct grilling, plus rotisserie. I have owned Weber products since 1969. Enough said!
Results.Title: Customer service and product satisfaction.

Results.ReviewText: The grill is well made and easy to clean. The ash catcher works great.
Results.Title: A classic that makes grilling fun

Results.ReviewText: Awesome BBQ and weber customer service is great.  Had a spot weld issue on the grate but called Weber and they immediately sent me a new one no questions asked and still have my old grate.
Results.Title: Great bbq!!

Results.ReviewText:
After 14 years of grilling on my old Weber, I received a new 22” kettle grill for Christmas. It was very easy to assemble, great instructions, and my wife and I really like the new Green!
I like the temperature gauge on the lid which I’ve never had before. I look forward to many years of charcoal grilling.
Results.Title: New Green grill

Results.ReviewText: I’m use to cooking on a grill where I can raise and lower the coals.  This is my first Weber.  Was worried I was going ruin a few meals before I got use to it but with the Weber app instructions on how they recommend to cook different things, everything has come out perfect every time
Results.Title: First Weber

Results.ReviewText: I was purchasing my first grill and on everyone’s recommendation went with Weber 22 inch Kettle Premium and I must say definitely a good decision. It’s very easy to use and with the help of I build thermometer, I can keep an eye on overall temp of the grill. The ash removal system is also great. You don’t have to worry that a gust of wind can spread your ash everywhere. Would definitely recommend!!
Results.Title: Very easy to use grill!!

Results.ReviewText: I bought mine slightly used for $20 but still a good piece of equipment. The Kettle design manages the heat very well as would any other grill. However, the quality of the components (sheet metal gauge, fasteners, etc.) will likely last a good while longer than a similar style kettle grill from Walmart (i.e. Expert Grill).  As with all things in life, you get what you pay for.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle Quality

Results.ReviewText: Nice, sturdy and easy to assemble grill. I like the added features of the premium package
Results.Title: Just get one

Results.ReviewText: Perfect for weekend bbq, easy to heat up for small meals and large enough that when we can gather in groups again
Results.Title: Perfect for backyard

Results.ReviewText:
Second Webber purchase, would highly recommend.  First grill was still in great shape, despite contestant year round use and being nearly 10 years old. Replaced due to grill lid being dented after falling off a truck while traveling from tailgate. 

I like the new features- temperature gage and easier clean out on new model.  My favorite grill by far to cook on.
Results.Title: Webber 22

Results.ReviewText: Great quality product. Tons of accessories available
Results.Title: Best charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to set up. I love the ash catcher system. I cooked steaks and then smoked a rack of baby back ribs the next day. Excellent value!
Results.Title: Weber 22.5” kettle

Results.ReviewText: Great charcoal grill! Looks nice and performs the way a Weber grill should.
Results.Title: Weber kettle grill

Results.ReviewText: The quintessential American grill but improved, only improvement would be to make it taller!
Results.Title: Semi fun stuff

Results.ReviewText:
I like the grill and think that it will be great for cooking, although I think that all of the kettle grills should come with lid bracket. 

Trying to check on food and having to search for the little hook on the inside of the top is a pain
Results.Title: I like

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, I grabbed after running into several issues with a certain pellet grill. All the automation gave a lot of room for stuff to not work. :-( my weber has never given issue, always works and I really like the grill opening so I can add coals if needed for longer indirect grilling. Can't go wrong!
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill, easy to use and easy to clean! I recommend it
Results.Title: The best grill

ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Simple, classic design. Only issue I have is with the three legs - they are made of the thinnest and cheapest metal that is the weak link of this grill. I anticipate them rusting/rotting out in a very short time. The other negative about the grill is the cost. Very expensive for a standard kettle grill of questionable quality.
Results.Title: Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is a remarkably good grill for the price. I think the addition of a cover would be a value-add at minimal price.
Results.Title: Good grill for the price

Results.ReviewText: Only thing I would change is, I would prefer a cast iron cooking grate.
Results.Title: Rick's Weber

Results.ReviewText: This is my fourth Weber Grill and I can't recommend them enough whether it be gas or charcoal. The Weber Kettle is the pinnacle of all charcoal cookers, they do it all. Love my new copper kettle and cant wait to get cooking on it.
Results.Title: Best Charcoal Grill Ever Made

Results.ReviewText: This is a very good grill I am very very satisfied with it. Before I had this grill I had a propane grill. It was okay for what it was worth. I got tired of always having to know how much propane was in the tank and having it turn off whenever it was it. With my weber kettle I don't have to worry about that problem I know how much charcoal I have in my grill and how much heat to allow my grill to have. And the charcoals last for hours when they are lit Properly. I love how the ashes fall to the bottom in the bowl and easy clean up afterwards. This is a very good product. I'd love to do more reviews on weber products if they presented themselves. Love the quality of the grill overall.
Results.Title: Excellent

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
